analyze_nutrient_gaps.params.foods: array of food eaten. each: { name, grams }.
analyze_nutrient_gaps.params.weightKg: body weight in kg (for scaling amino acid need)
browse_media.description: find movie or TV show by genre, year, rating, vote count. good for browsing, not name search.
build_meal_plan.description: make daily meal plan that hit nutrition target within calorie budget. use greedy optimizer to pick food that fill nutrient gap best. handle diet type (omnivore, vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, keto) and nutrient emphasis. use calculate_caloric_needs first to get calorie target.

calculate_hydration_needs.description: figure out daily water need based on body weight, activity, climate, exercise, altitude, and special condition (pregnancy, breastfeeding). use ACSM/IOM guidelines. give back total recommendation with timing.
calculate_hydration_needs.params.altitud: altitude in meter (>2500m = more water need)
calculate_hydration_needs.params.caffein: daily caffeine in mg (offset for diuretic effect)
check_breach.description: check if password or email show up in known data breach using Have I Been Pwned. password check use k-anonymity (free, no API key). email check need HIBP API key, give back breach detail.

check_drug_nutrient_interactions.descrip: check drug-nutrient interaction (DNI). see if medicine eat up nutrient, block absorption, or fight with vitamin/mineral. cover ~60 important interaction across statin, metformin, PPI, diuretic, antibiotic, anticonvulsant, corticosteroid, blood thinner, more. give back severity (major/moderate/minor), effect type, and what to do.
optional: comma-separated nutrient to check (e.g. 'calcium,iron'). skip for all.
check_sku_availability.description: check Best Buy Canada stock for specific SKU. good for checking product not on watchlist.
check_sku_availability.params.fields: comma-separated field to give back. got: count, lastCheck, inStockCount, results
check_sku_availability.params.skus: comma-separated Best Buy SKU number to check
compare_food_nutrition.description: compare nutrition side-by-side for 2+ raw whole food. example: chicken vs salmon vs tofu. give back matched food with per-100g nutrient value.
compare_food_nutrition.params.fields: comma-separated field to give back. got: name, description, kingdom, foodType, foodSubtype, part, form, state, taxonomy.taxon, taxonomy.kingdom, taxonomy.phylum, taxonomy.class, taxonomy.order, taxonomy.suborder, taxonomy.family, taxonomy.subfamily, taxonomy.tribe, taxonomy.genus, taxonomy.species, taxonomy.subspecies, taxonomy.variety, taxonomy.form, taxonomy.group, taxonomy.cultivar, taxonomy.phenotype, taxonomy.binomial, taxonomy.nomial, taxonomy.trinomial, perHundredGrams.macros, perHundredGrams.minerals, perHundredGrams.vitamins, perHundredGrams.aminoAcids, perHundredGrams.lipidProfile, perHundredGrams.carbDetails, perHundredGrams.sterols
compare_food_nutrition.params.nutrientTy: comma-separated nutrient type: macros, minerals, vitamins, amino_acids, lipids, carbs, sterols. skip for all.
compare_json.description: deep-compare two JSON object, give back all difference. show added, removed, changed, and type-changed value with full path. handle nested object and array.
control_browser.description:
control headless browser for web automation, E2E test, visual QA, and page that need JavaScript. each call do ONE action. browser session last between call (same sessionId) so you build multi-step flow.

BEST WAY: navigate → snapshot → click_ref/type_ref. 'snapshot' give back ARIA tree (role, name, state) which ~4x smaller than screenshot. show element like: heading "Title" [level=1], button "Submit", textbox "Search". use 'click_ref' or 'type_ref' with ref copy from snapshot — 'role:name' (ref="button:Submit") or snapshot own format 'role "name"' (ref='link "Home"'). no CSS selector needed.

SHORTCUT: 'screenshot', 'snapshot', 'get_content', 'get_elements' take optional 'url' to navigate first in same call.

OTHER WAY: navigate → get_elements → click/type (use CSS selector).

for complex multi-step browser thing, use 'execute_browser_script' instead — run full Playwright script in one call. session close after 5 min no activity.
control_browser.params.action: browser action to do. SNAPSHOT FLOW: 'snapshot' (ARIA tree — better than screenshot), 'click_ref' (click by snapshot ref), 'type_ref' (type by ref), 'hover_ref' (hover by ref), 'select_ref' (select dropdown by ref). SELECTOR FLOW: 'click' (click by CSS), 'type' (type by CSS), 'get_elements' (find interactive element). GENERAL: 'navigate' (go to URL), 'screenshot' (capture picture), 'scroll' (scroll page), 'evaluate' (run JS), 'get_content' (extract text/HTML), 'wait' (wait for element/time), 'close' (end session).
control_browser.params.expression: JavaScript to run in page (for 'evaluate'). return value become JSON.
control_browser.params.fullPage: if true, capture full scrollable page not just viewport (for 'screenshot').
control_browser.params.limit: max element to give back (for 'get_elements', default: 50, max: 100).
control_browser.params.pressEnter: if true, press Enter after type (for 'type' and 'type_ref'). good for search form.
control_browser.params.ref: element ref copy from 'snapshot' output: 'role:name' (like 'button:Submit', 'link:Home') or snapshot own format 'role "name"' (like 'link "Canada"'). use by 'click_ref', 'type_ref', 'hover_ref', 'select_ref'.
control_browser.params.sessionId: optional session ID for reuse same browser page across call. default 'default'. use different ID for parallel task.
control_browser.params.timeout: timeout in ms (for 'wait'; default 2000, or 10000 with selector; max 30000).
control_browser.params.url: URL to go to (need for 'navigate'; optional for 'screenshot'/'snapshot'/'get_content'/'get_elements' to navigate first in same call).
control_spotify.description: control Spotify playback on linked account device. action: play (track/album/playlist by uri, by search query, or resume), pause, next, previous, queue (add track), shuffle, repeat, volume, seek, transfer (move playback to device), save_track / unsave_track (like/unlike track). playback need Spotify open on at least one device and Premium account; if no device active, most recent one targeted automatic.
control_spotify.params.deviceId: target device ID from get_spotify action=devices (default: active or most recent device).
control_spotify.params.id: track ID, URI, or URL (for save_track/unsave_track).
control_spotify.params.mode: repeat mode (for repeat): off, track, or context.

control_spotify.params.uri: Spotify URI, URL, or ID of what to play or queue (track, album, playlist, artist, episode).

convert_currency.description: convert amount between any two currency using live exchange rate. handle 161 currency including USD, CAD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

convert_encoding.description: encode or decode data between format: Base64, Base64URL, hex, URL encoding, HTML entities, ROT13, binary, and JWT decode (no verify). both way — say encode or decode.
convert_image_to_ascii.description: turn picture into high-fidelity ASCII art. handle any URL (including image URL returned by other tool), base64 data URI, or previous imageId. got custom width, character set, contrast, density flip, and truecolor. give back raw ASCII, ANSI terminal string, and interactive HTML embed that render auto in result panel.

convert_image_to_ascii.params.input: picture source: any image URL (including image URL returned by other tool), base64 data URI, or imageId from prior manipulate_image call. if user attach picture but you have no URL, pass 'attached' — harness give newest attached picture.

convert_video_to_gif.description: turn video (MP4, WebM, MOV) into animated GIF using two-pass palette mapping. handle high-quality (custom 256-color palette) and small-file (128 color, low frame rate, no dither). take public URL or local path. convert_video_to_gif.params.input: source video: public URL, file:// URL, or local absolute path

convert_video_to_gif.params.width: target width in pixel. aspect ratio auto. default: 480 high, 320 low. range: 64-1280.
create_3d_mesh.description: make one 3D thing from raw triangle mesh — vertex and face index. best for single object you can count vertex by hand: pyramid, prism, wedge, gem, polyhedron, any clean shape — include shape not in create_3d_scene primitive list. rule: if you can write the few vertex and face yourself, use this for crisp custom mesh; for many-part, organic, or real-world thing (snowman, house, character, vehicle), or full scene, use create_3d_scene instead. can build step by step — break into part (base, wing, section) and call again with sessionId from first call to add more vertex and face. face index in next call are absolute (0-based from total accumulated vertex). between call, say what you just add and what come next. skip sessionId to start new. to put finish mesh into full scene with other object, light, camera — pass its sceneId to create_3d_scene as {"type": "asset", "assetId": "<sceneId>"}. 3D scene show auto in result panel — no put URL in text. max 50,000 vertex and 100,000 face per session.
create_3d_mesh.params.colors: optional per-vertex color as CSS string. must match vertex count.
create_3d_mesh.params.faces: array of triangle face index. each face [v0, v1, v2] pointing to vertex.
create_3d_mesh.params.normals: optional per-vertex normal [nx, ny, nz]. must match vertex count. skip to auto-compute.
create_3d_mesh.params.options.params.cam: camera position [x, y, z]. skip for auto-fit.
create_3d_mesh.params.options.params.fla: flat shading for faceted look (default: true)
create_3d_mesh.params.options.params.mes: mesh color if no vertex color (default: '#38bdf8')
create_3d_mesh.params.sessionId: optional session ID from earlier create_3d_mesh call, to add more vertex and face to that mesh. skip to start new mesh — server give sessionId back. wrong or expired (30 min) session ID get rejected.
create_3d_mesh.params.vertices: array of vertex position. each [x, y, z].
create_3d_scene.description: make any 3D object, model, or full scene by combining primitive shape with PBR material, transform, hierarchical grouping, built-in animation, environment lighting preset, ground plane, and 3D text label. this the main 3D building tool and right default for many-part, organic, or real-world thing (snowman, house, character, vehicle) and any full scene with light, ground, or camera. (for one simple object you could count vertex by hand — lone pyramid, prism, polyhedron — create_3d_mesh give cleaner custom mesh; grab that instead.) object type: box, sphere, cylinder, cone, pyramid, torus, torusKnot, plane, ring, circle, dodecahedron, icosahedron, octahedron, tetrahedron, capsule, group (container for children), text3d (3D text label), asset (place earlier saved mesh, model, or scene build by sceneId — e.g. build detail geometry with create_3d_mesh, then put it here among other object). built-in animation: spin, bounce, orbit, pulse, float. environment preset: studio, outdoor, night, sunset, dawn, warehouse, neutral. support ground plane with shadow, fog, camera control, auto-orbit. interactive 3D scene show automatically in tool result panel — do NOT put URL or link in your text response. max 300 total object (include nested children and expanded asset), max 5 level of nesting. when human attach picture, set textureUrl to 'reference' on object that should show it. no search web for image URL. build step by step with returned sessionId — next call append object.

create_3d_scene.params.objects.items.par: child object — ONLY render when this object type is 'group'. same structure as parent object array.
child object — take same field as top-level object (type, size, radius, height, position, rotation, scale, material, animation, content, fontSize).
optional texture picture URL to wrap around shape
optional texture picture URL to wrap around shape
the object type: primitive shape name, 'group' (container for children), 'text3d' (text label), or 'asset' (place saved build via assetId). 'shape' work as alias for this field.

create_calendar_event.description: make new event on Google Calendar. set title, start/end time, optional detail, location, attendee, and timezone.
create_cron_job.description: make lasting cron job or manual/event-driven trigger. cron job persist across session and run unattended in background. handle hourly, daily (at scheduleTime), weekly (on scheduleDay at scheduleTime), cron expression (via cronExpression), or trigger (fire manually using trigger_cron_job).

create_custom_agent.params.avatar: picture URL or data URL for custom avatar. take precedence over icon. accept URL, data URL (base64), or static asset path. leave empty to use Lucide icon.
create_custom_agent.params.backgroundIma: URL for background picture behind chat message. use subtle, dark picture for readability. leave empty for default.
create_custom_agent.params.color: hex color code for accent theme. like: '#6366f1' (Indigo), '#8b5cf6' (Violet), '#ef4444' (Red). leave empty for default gradient.

create_custom_agent.params.enabledTools: array of tool name this agent can use. if empty, no tool access. pass specific tool name (like ['read_file', 'write_file', 'search_web']).
create_custom_agent.params.guidelines: behavior instruction for how agent respond. always injected into system prompt.
create_custom_agent.params.icon: Lucide icon name for visual branding (when no avatar). default: 'Bot'. like: 'Brain', 'Rocket', 'Shield', 'Palette', 'Code2', 'Flame', 'Zap'.
create_custom_agent.params.identity: core personality and role prompt — injected at top of system prompt.

create_custom_agent.params.toolPolicy: instruction for how agent use tool.
create_custom_agent.params.usesCodingGui: if true, inject coding convention into system prompt. default: false.
create_custom_agent.params.usesDirectory: if true, inject work cave file structure into agent context. good for code agent. default: false.
create_task.description: make lasting task to track work across agentic iteration. task survive context truncation and memory consolidation — reliable working memory for complex multi-step work. use when starting complex task to keep checklist, track progress on multi-file refactor, or record item that must not be lost. give back created task with unique numeric ID.
create_task.params.activeForm: present continuous form shown as spinner (like 'Running tests', 'Refactoring auth module').
create_task.params.description: detailed description of what need to be done.
create_task.params.subject: brief title for task (like 'Migrate auth middleware to JWT').
create_vector_animation.description: make interactive vector keyframe animation in HTML5 Canvas — Flash-style display list with layer, reusable symbol, and tweening. handle shape (rectangle, circle, ellipse, line, polygon, path, text), transform/color tween with easing preset (also bounce, elastic, back, spring), SVG path morph (shape tween), motion path, gradient, image fill, layer parenting ('parent') with invisible 'group' layer, z-order (zIndex), clipping mask (isMask + maskedBy), blur/drop-shadow filter, and reusable symbol with own looping timeline (animation.symbols + 'instance' layer). WORKFLOW — build step by step, one call per step, not one shot: 1) first call: send canvas basics (width, height, duration, fps, background) plus only 1-3 most important layer with rough keyframe — response give sessionId and live animation human see right away. 2) next call: pass exact sessionId and only layer you add or change — layer merge by id, keyframe merge by time, {"action": "delete"} remove layer, replaceKeyframes: true swap layer whole timeline, session keep for 7 day. 3) CHECK WORK: pass options.snapshot: true to get filmstrip picture of frame across timeline, filmstrip attach to result for you to inspect (if model no see picture, pass snapshot.url to describe_image) — check it before polish. 4) keep going: fix timing and easing, then add secondary motion and polish. build character and multi-part thing as layer parented to one 'group' layer so one keyframe track move whole assembly; define repeat motion (walk cycle, spin wheel, blink) once as symbol and stamp with instance layer. use options.export ('mp4' or 'gif') only when human want shareable file. animation show automatic in tool result panel — no put URL or link in text response. when human attach picture, set imageUrl to 'reference' on layer that should show it — system swap 'reference' for real picture automatic; leave imageUrl unset on solid color layer. no search web for image URL. preset shape (star, heart, arrow, gear) save you from hand-writing SVG path. use animation.retime to change pacing without resending keyframe. every response include 'warnings' for silent problem (off-canvas layer, invisible layer) — fix them before polish.
create_vector_animation.params.animation: vector animation definition.
canvas background color (default: '#ffffff').
optional. if true, clear whole session and reset to this new input.
total duration in second (default: 5.0).
frame per second for playback (default: 24, range: 1-60).
canvas height in pixel (default: 600, max: 1080).
list of animated vector layer/object.
optional. set to 'delete' to remove layer from session.
unique ID for this layer.
optional picture URL to fill shape with (via clipping). handle standard format and base64 data URL.
keyframe timeline defining animated transition for property.

easing function to transition to NEXT keyframe: 'linear', 'ease-in', 'ease-out', 'ease-in-out', 'step'/'discrete' (hold — for frame-by-frame), 'bounce', 'bounce-in', 'elastic', 'elastic-in', 'back' (overshoot), 'back-in', 'spring', or 'cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2)'. unknown easing name get rejected.
optional SVG path along which shape coordinate glide to next keyframe.
rotate shape auto to follow curve tangent (default: false).
SVG path data (d attribute, like 'M 0 0 C 100 0, 100 200, 200 200').

target property value at this keyframe. handle: x, y, scaleX, scaleY, rotation, opacity, fillColor, strokeColor, strokeWidth, width, height, radius, rx, ry, points, path (SVG d-string — different path morph/shape-tween between keyframe), text, fontSize, imageUrl, blur, shadowColor, shadowBlur, shadowOffsetX, shadowOffsetY.
time in second for this keyframe (must be 0.0 to duration).
default opacity (0-1, default: 1.0).
optional. if true, overwrite all keyframe of layer instead of merge.

static shape property (like {width: 100, height: 100} for rectangle, {radius: 50} for circle, {points: [[x,y],...]} for polygon, {path: 'M...'} for path, {text, fontSize} for text). preset shape: star {spikes, outerRadius, innerRadius}, heart {size}, arrow {length, thickness}, gear {teeth, outerRadius, innerRadius, holeRadius}. to change preset parameter later, resend shapeType with new shapeData.

shape type for this layer: rectangle, circle, ellipse, line, polygon, path, text, 'group' (invisible transform node — parent other layer to it to move them together), or 'instance' (stamp symbol from animation.symbols; set 'symbol'). required for new layer; can skip when updating layer that already exist in session.
default outline stroke width in pixel.
canvas width in pixel (default: 800, max: 1920).
create_vector_animation.params.options.p: optional title show as overlay at top of animation player.
create_vector_animation.params.sessionId: optional session ID to update existing animation. skip on first call — server give one back in response, use that exact one to edit. session keep for 7 day after last edit; wrong or expired session ID get rejected.
delete_cron_job.description: delete cron job or trigger by UUID or name.
delete_cron_job.params.scheduleId: UUID or exact name of cron job to delete.
delete_datastore.description: delete record from datastore namespace. target one of three way: 'ids' (record id from query_datastore), 'filter' (mongo-style query), or 'all: true' to wipe whole namespace. delete without target = rejected.
delete_datastore.params.all: set true to delete every record in namespace. required when no 'ids' and no 'filter'.
delete_datastore.params.filter: mongo-style filter selecting record to delete, like {"date": {"$lt": "2026-01-01"}}.
delete_datastore.params.ids: record id to delete ('id' value from query_datastore).
delete_file.description: delete file or directory from work cave. give back file size deleted (or 0 for directory). use for cleanup, removing folder, or deleting old code.
delete_file.params.path: absolute path of file or directory to delete.
delete_file.params.recursive: if true, recursively delete directory and all content. default: false, only delete individual file.
remove_background.description: remove background from EXISTING picture, keep subject original pixel untouched (no AI re-draw). give back see-through PNG shown to human auto. use when human want cut out real photo (person, pet, product). for MAKING new picture with no background, use generate_image with transparentBackground instead.
remove_background.params.image: picture to cut out: http(s) URL, base64 data URI, or imageId from previous manipulate_image call. if user attach picture but you have no URL, pass 'attached' — harness give newest attached picture.
remove_background.params.subject: what to keep, plain word (like 'the person', 'the dog', 'the red car'). skip to keep main subject.
detect_objects.description: find object in picture with bounding box. give instruction like 'all dog', 'damage on fender', or 'every green thing' and get back label with exact box coordinate, plus copy of picture with box drawn on (shown to human auto). use for counting thing, pointing where something is, or visual inspection question.

generate_audio.description: make audio/music clip (WAV) with step-grid TRACKER sequencer — synth instrument, BUILT-IN NATURAL SAMPLE LIBRARY (sampleSource: 'preset:kick' … 'preset:bell' — real-sound drum, pluck guitar/bass, e-piano, marimba, bell), AND external audio sample (user upload, generated speech, any audio URL) play as pitched instrument or sequenced as drum/beat hit. use for chiptune, retro game music, sound effect, melody, sample beat, multi-track composition. WORKFLOW — call tool once per step: 1) action: 'init' make session (set tempo, timeSignature, linesPerBeat, duration in second — final render exactly that long). 2) action: 'add_channel' once per instrument (pass sessionId from init; can include 'rows' to write pattern same call). 3) action: 'write_pattern' add or extend channel note rows. 4) action: 'render' for final mixed output. STEP GRID: each row fixed time slot of 60/tempo/linesPerBeat second (default linesPerBeat: 4 = 16th note). row is {note, duration, velocity?}: duration = how many grid step note ring — integer like 4, or beat fraction like '1/4' (quarter note), '1/8', '1/4d' (dotted), '1/4t' (triplet). note: pitch name ('C4', 'F#3'), chord auto-expand ('Cmaj7', 'Am'), drum ('KICK', 'SNARE', 'HAT' — drum synthesis automatic, no instrument need), rest ('REST'), sustain ('---'), note-off ('==='). channel take instrument preset (18 available, like piano, synth_bass, violin), raw waveform, OR real audio sample via sampleSource ('attached' user audio, or URL like previous synthesize_speech/remix_audio result) that pattern note repitch tracker-style — plus per-channel effect (reverb, delay, filter, distortion), volume, per-note pitch bend. session support swing, humanize, time signature. every add_channel/write_pattern step auto-render live audio preview of what written so far, plus authored-vs-target duration progress — use remainingDuration to decide if write more rows. pattern shorter than target auto-loop at render; longer trimmed to exact target. between call, describe what just added and what come next.
generate_audio.params.action: REQUIRED tracker workflow action. 'init' make session, 'add_channel' add instrument channel (can include inline rows), 'write_pattern' add note rows to channel, 'render' make final output.
generate_audio.params.append: for write_pattern: if true (default), append row. if false, overwrite from startRow.
generate_audio.params.channelId: channel name for add_channel/write_pattern (like 'melody', 'bass', 'drums'). must be unique per session.
generate_audio.params.clearSession: for render: delete session after render. default: false.
generate_audio.params.duration: target duration in second, pass during action: 'init' (range: 0.1-60.0). final render EXACTLY this long: short pattern auto-loop to fill, long content trimmed with fade. skip to render natural pattern length.
generate_audio.params.effects: channel effect chain for add_channel action.
generate_audio.params.humanize: timing humanize (0.0-1.0), pass during init. add random per-note jitter (±20ms at max) so grid timing feel natural.
generate_audio.params.instrument: instrument preset for add_channel — set channel waveform and envelope to approximate instrument timbre. for drum, skip this and write KICK/SNARE/HAT rows instead (drum synthesis automatic).
generate_audio.params.linesPerBeat: step grid resolution: number of row per beat (default: 4 = 16th note). at 120 BPM with linesPerBeat=4, each row = 0.125s. use 2 for 8th note, 4 for 16th, 8 for 32nd. pass during action: 'init'.
generate_audio.params.nodes: ADVANCED, for add_channel: custom DSP node graph replace auto-built instrument chain. key are unique node name referenced by 'nodeChain'. node type: 'oscillator', 'noise', 'biquad_filter', 'envelope', 'gain', 'distortion', 'stereo_panner', 'delay', 'reverb', 'drum_synth'.
generate_audio.params.nodeChain: ADVANCED, for add_channel with 'nodes': ordered signal chain of node name from generator to effect. every name must exist as key in 'nodes'. example: ['osc', 'env', 'filter'].
generate_audio.params.rows: note rows for write_pattern (or inline with add_channel). each row take grid steps from its duration. rows append in order; use append=false with startRow to overwrite.
note name ('C4', 'D#5'), chord ('Am7', 'Cmaj', 'G7' — auto-expand), drum ('KICK', 'SNARE', 'HAT' — synthesized automatic, keep drum on own channel), rest ('REST'), sustain ('---'), or note-off ('===', 'OFF').

REQUIRED. how long note ring: integer grid steps (1-64, like 4), or beat fraction string — '1/4' = quarter note (one beat), '1/8', '1/2', '1/4d' (dotted), '1/4t' (triplet). use 1 for short staccato hit.
optional pitch bend/glide to target note during playback. for guitar bend, slide, portamento.
target note name or frequency to bend toward (like 'G3', 440).
fraction of note duration when bend start (0.0-1.0, default: 0.0).
fraction of note duration when bend reach target (0.0-1.0, default: 1.0).
generate_audio.params.sampleLoop: for sampler channel (add_channel with sampleSource): true = sample loop while note held, long note ring past sample end. default: false (one-shot, like classic tracker).
generate_audio.params.sampleRootNote: for sampler channel: pitch recording assumed at (like 'C4', 'A#3'). pattern note repitch sample relative to this — C5 row play twice fast/octave up. default: 'C4'. for unpitched thing (drum hit, speech, foley) keep default, write row at root note or KICK/SNARE/HAT trigger.
generate_audio.params.sampleSource: for add_channel: make SAMPLER channel that play real audio recording as instrument instead of synth waveform — classic tracker way. BUILT-IN LIBRARY: pass 'preset:<name>' (like preset:piano) for natural physically-modeled one-shot — drum/percussion: kick, snare, hat, hat_open, clap, tom, rim, crash, ride, tambourine, shaker, cowbell, woodblock, triangle, conga, bongo, claves; melodic (auto root note, repitch by rows): piano, epiano, harpsichord, organ, church_organ, accordion, guitar_pluck, nylon_guitar, bass_pluck, harp, banjo, mandolin, marimba, vibraphone, xylophone, glockenspiel, kalimba, bell, tubular_bell, music_box, steel_drum, timpani, violin, cello, strings, choir, flute, clarinet, trumpet, brass. these sound more real than synth 'instrument' preset — prefer for natural music; use 'instrument' for chiptune/synth timbre. EXTERNAL AUDIO: pass 'attached' for audio user attach to conversation, audio URL (like audioRef from previous synthesize_speech or generate_audio result), or data URI. only first 15s of source decoded — trim longer audio down to wanted moment first. to sample sound from web, search tool discovery for 'sample a sound from the web' — recipe cover full chain. audio decoded (first 15s max), each pattern note replay it repitched relative to sampleRootNote; KICK/SNARE/HAT row play natural pitch. always use public https URL — never internal ref. channel make NO SOUND until write pattern rows trigger it then render: after add_channel, write rows at each time sample should play (1s sample need duration cover ~1s of grid step), then call render. EVERY row retrigger sample from start — short sample on repeating rows become drum machine beat, stutter, or vocal chop, and one channel per sample build full kit (kick channel, snare channel, vocal channel — up to 16, 60s decoded sample audio total per session). no combine with instrument, waveform, or nodes. channel effect, volume, velocity all still work.
generate_audio.params.sessionId: tracker session ID (from action: 'init'). need for add_channel, write_pattern, render.
generate_audio.params.startRow: for write_pattern: row index to start overwrite (0-based). only when append=false.
generate_audio.params.swing: groove swing amount (0.0-1.0), pass during init. shift every other 16th note forward. 0.0 = straight, 0.5 = triplet shuffle.
generate_audio.params.tempo: tempo in beat per minute (default: 120, range: 20-300). pass during action: 'init'.
generate_audio.params.timeSignature: time signature as [beatsPerBar, beatUnit]. like [4,4] for 4/4, [3,4] for waltz. default: [4,4].
generate_audio.params.waveform: raw oscillator wave shape for add_channel when no instrument preset (default: 'sine'). override preset waveform if both set.

generate_chart.params.datasets: one or more data series. for pie chart use single dataset. example: [{"label": "Sales", "data": [120, 190, 300, 500]}]. required when making new (no chartId); merge by label when updating.

generate_chart.params.title: optional chart title

generate_csv.params.columns: optional explicit column order. if skip, use key from first object.

generate_csv.params.data: array of object to convert to CSV. each object become one row.
generate_diagram.description: render Mermaid diagram (flowchart, sequence, class, ER, Gantt, state, pie, git graph) as interactive embedded page. build big diagram step by step: start with core structure (response give diagramId), then call again with diagramId and only new lines — they append to existing definition. diagram show automatic in tool result panel — no put URL or link in text response — human already see it rendered above.
generate_diagram.params.diagramId: optional. pass diagramId from earlier call to ADD new definition lines to that diagram (send only new nodes/edges/participants, not whole diagram). leave out to make new diagram — then 'definition' must be complete, start with diagram type header.
generate_hash.description: make cryptographic hash and HMAC. handle MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and all Node.js crypto algorithm. output in hex, base64, or other encoding. use for checksum, data verification, fingerprinting.
generate_hash.params.algorithm: hash algorithm: md5, sha1, sha256, sha512, etc. (default: sha256)
generate_hash.params.key: optional HMAC key. if given, compute HMAC instead of plain hash.
generate_image.description: make or edit picture using AI picture generation. when reference picture attached, they auto passed to model — write SHORT edit instruction (like 'Make this blue'). no re-describe attached picture. when NO reference picture attached, write rich detailed prompt. made picture go to human auto. IMPORTANT: no call this tool unless human explicitly ask for picture, drawing, painting, or artwork. never call for greeting or casual talk. when draw specific people from attached reference, call each person in prompt by EXACTLY the name their reference picture labeled with, and only name people whose reference actually attached — name with no attached reference get made-up likeness.
generate_image.params.prompt: when reference picture attached: write SHORT edit instruction. when NO picture attached: write detailed prompt with style, composition, subject, color, mood, lighting. model know real world: can give GPS coordinate (decimal or DMS) plus optional date/time to draw real outdoor place with correct terrain, season, sun position (like '49.2827, -123.1207 at sunset in January').

generate_image.params.transparentBackgro: set true when human want cut-out, sticker, logo, or see-through background PNG (subject alone, no background). work for new picture AND for edit of attached picture (re-draw subject without background). no describe any background in prompt when using this. no good for mostly-green subject. to cut out EXISTING photo without re-draw (pixel-faithful), use remove_background tool instead.
generate_image.params.aspectRatio: picture shape. default 1:1. use 16:9 for banner/desktop wallpaper, 9:16 for phone wallpaper/story, 21:9 for ultrawide, 2:3/3:4 for portrait and poster. match what human will use picture for.
generate_image.params.size: picture resolution: 1K (default), 2K, or 4K. use 2K/4K only when human ask for high resolution, wallpaper, or print — bigger size cost more and slower.

get_container_diagnostics.description: get Docker container resource usage and performance metric across all host. action: 'stats' (live CPU%, memory, network, block-IO, throttling, PID), 'metrics' (time-series history), 'history' (recent ring-buffer snapshot from last 5 min), 'system' (Docker host OS, kernel, CPU count, total memory, disk usage).
get_container_diagnostics.params.contain: filter by container name (partial match). for action=stats and action=metrics.
get_container_diagnostics.params.limit: max data point for metric history (action=metrics). default: 120.
get_container_diagnostics.params.range: time range for metric history (action=metrics). default: '1h'.
get_container_logs.description: get recent log from Docker container with optional filter. give back log line with timestamp and stream source (stdout/stderr). handle filter by severity (cascading: 'warn' give back WARN + ERROR), substring search, and time window. when 'container' given, get log from that one. when skip, search ALL running container and merge by time order — good for cross-service debugging.
get_container_logs.params.container: Docker container name (like 'prism-service'). if skip, fetch from ALL running container and merge.
get_container_logs.params.device: target device ID if container run on specific host.
get_container_logs.params.level: filter by minimum log severity. cascading: 'error' show only ERROR, 'warn' show WARN+ERROR, 'info' show INFO+OK+WARN+ERROR, 'debug' show everything.
get_container_logs.params.search: case-insensitive substring to search in log line. only line containing this text returned (like 'timeout', 'OOM').
get_container_logs.params.since: relative time window. format: number + unit (s/m/h/d). like '5m', '1h', '30s'. only log within this window returned.
get_container_logs.params.tail: how many log line from end (default: 200, max: 2000). applied before filter. when searching all container, limit apply per container.
get_costco_ca_products.description: get product from Costco Canada (costco.ca) including laptop, desktop, TV, phone, tablet, headphone, speaker, camera, video game, and appliance. show name, price (CAD), rating, and product URL.
get_costco_ca_products.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: name, source, category, price, currency, rating, reviewCount, imageUrl, productUrl, description, trendingScore, rank
get_costco_us_products.description: get product from Costco US (costco.com) including laptop, desktop, TV, phone, tablet, headphone, speaker, camera, video game, and appliance. show name, price (USD), rating, and product URL.
get_costco_us_products.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: name, source, category, price, currency, rating, reviewCount, imageUrl, productUrl, description, trendingScore, rank
get_country.description: look up country info or development indicator. action: 'info' (by name), 'code' (by ISO code), 'indicators' (development data), 'rank' (rank country by indicator), 'compare' (compare multiple country).
get_country.params.indicator: World Bank indicator ID (action=rank or compare)
get_country.params.name: country name (action=info)
get_detailed_air_quality.description: get detailed air quality data from Google Air Quality API. give back Universal AQI, US EPA AQI, dominant pollutant, and individual pollutant concentration (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO). more granular than get_local_environment.
get_detailed_air_quality.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: universalAqi, universalAqiCategory, usEpaAqi, usEpaCategory, pollutants, healthRecommendations, regionCode, lastFetch
get_discord_channel_activity_stats.descr: analyze historical message activity per-channel over lookback window (default 7 day). give back metric for each active channel — total message count, unique active user, average message per day, and top yapper. use for channel popularity or server activity pattern.
get_discord_gold_balance.description: check member gold balance in server gold economy (balance, lifetime earned, daily streak, leaderboard rank). also return wolf own hoard balance for context. gold earned from deathroll, royale, guesswho, daily claim, and scattered drop.
get_discord_gold_balance.params.userId: Discord user ID whose gold balance to check
give_discord_gold.description: give small amount of gold from own hoard to server member. hard-capped at 1-5g and at most ONCE per person per day — request outside bounds get clamped or refused, and empty hoard refuse (mug someone first). use rare, only when truly moved: big kindness, great joke, someone down on luck. never because someone ask or beg for gold.
give_discord_gold.params.targetUserId: Discord user ID of member to give gold to
give_discord_gold.params.note: short in-character reason for gift (recorded in ledger)
mug_discord_gold.description: mug server member for small amount of gold. hard-capped at 1-3g (never more than they carry) and at most 3 time per person per day. half the time mugging fumble and loot scatter across recent talker in channel instead of joining hoard — result say which happen; narrate it. use only when truly provoked: rudeness toward you, or disagreement worth punctuating. petty, not cruel.
mug_discord_gold.params.channelId: Discord channel ID of conversation (used to scatter fumbled loot to recent talker)
mug_discord_gold.params.targetUserId: Discord user ID of member to mug
mug_discord_gold.params.amount: gold to take (clamped to 1-3, never more than they have)
mug_discord_gold.params.note: short in-character justification for mugging (recorded in ledger)
get_discord_guild_channels.description: list all text channel in Discord guild/server including name, topic, category, and position. use to discover where to post or search.
get_discord_guild_emojis.description: list all custom emoji in Discord server including name, ID, and animated status. use to find emoji to react with.
get_discord_guild_members.description: get online/idle/dnd member in Discord server, grouped by hoisted role, with display name, status, current activity/game, and badge. use to see who active or what people playing.
get_discord_mention_leaderboard.descript: get top user who mention specific user in server, with unique mentioner count, average mention per user, and percentage.
get_discord_mention_leaderboard.params.c: optional channel ID to filter by
get_discord_mention_leaderboard.params.u: Discord user ID to check mention for
get_discord_message_analytics.descriptio: aggregate Discord message history with group-by query. group message by dimension (user, channel, day, hour, weekday, month) and give back counted result sorted by count. handle all same filter as search_discord_messages. use for 'who talk most?', 'which channel most active?', 'show monthly trend'.
get_discord_message_analytics.params.aft: ISO date string — only message after this date
get_discord_message_analytics.params.bef: ISO date string — only message before this date
get_discord_message_analytics.params.gro: dimension to group by. 'user' = per-author count, 'channel' = per-channel, 'day' = per-day, 'hour' = by hour (0-23 UTC), 'weekday' = by day of week, 'month' = by month. default: 'user'.
get_discord_message_analytics.params.que: text filter — only count message containing this text.
get_discord_message_analytics.params.use: filter to message by specific user ID
filter by username or display name (case-insensitive)
get_discord_message_leaderboard.descript: get top contributor by message count on server for lookback window, including total message, active user, and average per user.
get_discord_message_leaderboard.params.c: optional channel ID to filter by (default to all)
get_discord_server_activity.description: get Discord server activity stat including top user (by message count), channel breakdown, hourly distribution, and engagement metric. good for leaderboard, active user, server health. handle configurable lookback (default: 7 day).
get_discord_server_activity.params.chann: narrow analysis to specific channel ID
get_discord_server_activity.params.topN: how many top user to return (default: 15, max: 50)
get_discord_user_heatmap_data.descriptio: get hourly and monthly activity heatmap data for human on Discord server. give back 7x48 hourly grid and month-by-month metric. use to analyze when human most active.
get_discord_user_heatmap_data.params.cha: optional channel ID to filter by
get_discord_user_profile.description: get comprehensive profile of Discord user in specific server. include display name, custom status, platform, role list, highest role, voice state, join/boost timestamp, profile color, and moderation permission.
get_discord_user_profile.params.userId: Discord user ID to fetch profile for
get_discord_voice_channel_members.descri: get real-time list of all voice and stage channel with active member, including name and voice state (muted, deafened, streaming, camera). use to see who talking, streaming, or in voice.
get_discord_word_frequencies.description: get word frequency analysis (most common word) for human in Discord server, excluding stop word. good for seeing what topic or phrase human use most.
get_dota.description: get Dota 2 game data from OpenDota API. action: heroes (list all with stat), hero (detail by name/ID), matchups (best/worst matchup), player (profile by Steam32 ID), player_matches (recent match), match (detailed match data), pro_matches (pro match).
get_drug_adverse_events.description: get FDA adverse event report for drug, including reported reaction, seriousness (death, hospitalization, life-threatening), and patient demographic.
get_drug_adverse_events.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: safetyReportId, receiveDate, serious, seriousnessDetails, reactions, patientAge, patientSex
get_drug_recalls.description: get FDA drug recall and enforcement action. give back recall classification, reason, affected product, and recalling firm.
get_drug_recalls.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: recallNumber, status, classification, reportDate, recallingFirm, reason, productDescription, distribution
get_drug_recalls.params.q: optional search term for recall (drug name or keyword)
get_earnings_calendar.description: get upcoming earnings calendar showing which company reporting, with estimated and actual EPS and revenue.
get_earnings_calendar.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: date, epsActual, epsEstimate, hour, quarter, revenueActual, revenueEstimate, symbol, year
get_earthquakes.description: get recent earthquake data from USGS. give back seismic event with magnitude, location, depth, tsunami alert, and significance. handle filter by lookback hour, minimum magnitude, and limit.
get_earthquakes.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: usgsId, magnitude, magnitudeType, magnitudeClass, place, time, url, felt, alert, tsunami, significance, title, latitude, longitude, depth
get_earthquakes.params.minMag: minimum magnitude filter (like 4.0 for significant only)
get_electricity_retail_sales.description: get U.S. electricity retail sales data including price (cents/kWh), revenue, sales volume, and customer count. filter by state and sector.
get_element.description: query periodic table. action: 'search' (text search), 'lookup' (by symbol), 'rank' (rank by property), 'categories' (list category).
get_element.params.block: filter by block (s, p, d, f)
get_element.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: atomicNumber, symbol, name, atomicMass, category, groupNumber, period, block, electronConfiguration, electronegativity, density, molarHeat, summary
get_emoji_combination.description: combine two emoji to get Google Emoji Kitchen mashup picture. accept emoji character or hex codepoint. give back static PNG URL and metadata. returned image URL can use as input to any other tool that accept image URL.
get_emoji_combination.params.left: first emoji character or hex codepoint (like '🐼' or '1f43c')
get_emoji_combination.params.right: second emoji character or hex codepoint (like '❄️' or '2744-fe0f')
get_emoji_combinations.description: get all GBoard Emoji Kitchen combination for single emoji. give back list of other emoji it can combine with and mashup image URL.
get_emoji_combinations.params.emoji: emoji character or hex codepoint (like '🐼' or '1f43c')
get_energy_catalog.description: browse EIA data catalog tree. start with no route for top-level category (petroleum, electricity, natural-gas, coal, etc.), then drill down to discover dataset, frequency, and facet.
get_energy_catalog.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: id, name, description, routes, frequency, facets, data, startPeriod, endPeriod
get_energy_catalog.params.route: data route path to browse (like 'electricity', 'petroleum/pri'). leave empty for top-level.
get_energy_facets.description: get available facet value for EIA data route. use to discover valid filter value (like state ID, sector ID, product code) before querying energy data.
get_energy_facets.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: route, facetId, totalFacets, facets
get_energy_indicators.description: get curated snapshot of key U.S. energy indicator including gasoline price, diesel price, crude oil (WTI/Brent), natural gas price and storage, average electricity price, coal production, and nuclear outage percentage.
get_energy_indicators.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: id, name, category, value, period, unit, description
get_events.description: get event for any city in world, or local community event when no city given. pass 'city' to search global (like 'Toronto', 'Seattle', 'London, UK') — tool handle geocoding and fetching from Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, Craigslist, and TMDb automatic. action: 'search' (full-text with optional source/category), 'upcoming' (next N day), 'today' (today event), 'summary' (aggregate stat).
get_events.params.city: city name for location event search (like 'Toronto', 'Seattle', 'London, UK', 'Tokyo'). skip for local Vancouver event.
get_exoplanet.description: query NASA exoplanet database. action: 'search' (text search), 'lookup' (by name), 'rank' (rank by property), 'stats' (discovery statistic), 'habitable' (habitable zone planet).
get_exoplanet.params.name: planet name (action=lookup)
get_fear_greed_index.description: get Crypto Fear & Greed Index — sentiment gauge 0 (Extreme Fear) to 100 (Extreme Greed). show current value, classification, and historical trend. good for contrarian analysis.
get_fear_greed_index.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: current, history
get_fear_greed_index.params.limit: how many historical day to include (default: 30)
get_file_info.description: get metadata about one or more file without reading content. give back: exists, isFile, isDirectory, sizeBytes, lines, lastModified, extension, isBinary. use to check if file exist, figure out size, or inspect metadata. handle batch query (up to 20 path).
get_file_info.params.path: absolute path to inspect. use for single file.
get_file_info.params.paths: array of absolute path to inspect (max 20). use for batch.
get_flight_status.description: get real-time flight status info. look up flight by IATA number, departure/arrival airport, or airline. give back flight status, gate, terminal, scheduled/estimated/actual time, delay, and live tracking coordinate.
get_nutrition_reference.description: reference/discovery for food nutrition database. topic='categories': kingdom, food type, subtype, part and nutrient category. topic='nutrients': every nutrient in one category with column name. topic='taxonomy': biological taxonomy tree (maybe single rank, or child of parent via parentRank+parentValue).
get_nutrition_reference.params.topic: what to list: 'categories' (available filter + nutrient category), 'nutrients' (need category), or 'taxonomy' (tree of biological rank)
get_nutrition_reference.params.category: for topic='nutrients': which nutrient category to list
get_nutrition_reference.params.rank: for topic='taxonomy': give value for just this rank
get_nutrition_reference.params.parentRan: for topic='taxonomy': with parentValue, list child value under parent taxon
get_free_busy.description: query free/busy status for one or more Google Calendar within time range. give back busy time slot for each calendar. good for scheduling meeting.
get_free_busy.params.calendarIds: array of calendar ID to check.
get_github_trending.description: get today trending GitHub repo. give back name, description, language, total star, today star, and fork count. can filter by language.
get_gym_exercise_by_id.description: get detail for specific gym exercise by exact ID.
get_gym_exercise_by_id.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: id, name, force, level, mechanic, equipment, category, primary_muscles, secondary_muscles, instructions
get_gym_exercise_categories.description: get all available gym exercise category, equipment type, and muscle group.
get_historical_prices.description: get OHLCV candlestick data for any stock, ETF, index, crypto, or commodity. handle intraday (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h) through monthly interval. essential for price history and charting.
get_historical_prices.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: symbol, interval, period, currency, exchangeName, count, candles
get_infrastructure_status.description: get health and status of all deployed service and device. action: 'services' (registry with health, response time, error), 'devices' (physical host with hosted service), 'summary' (aggregate count of healthy/unhealthy service).
get_web_analytics.description: get unified web analytics for user own web property (website/app). merge two source per property: Google Analytics (GA4) and first-party sessions-service, joined on shared registry id so each property reported ONCE with whichever source have data. IMPORTANT: GA session and sessions-service session measured different, so two reported side by side and never summed — each property 'headline' block pick one primary source (GA when available, else first-party) for single coherent number set. default give back overview (session, pageview, visitor, avg session duration, engagement/bounce rate, plus period-over-period delta from GA) for every property. use 'property' to focus one site, 'source' to restrict one analytics source, and 'breakdown' to drill into time series, top page, traffic source, geography, or device.
get_web_analytics.params.property: optional filter to single web property. match registry id / project slug (like 'rod-dev-client'), domain (like 'rod.dev'), numeric GA property id, or property label. skip to get every tracked property.
get_web_analytics.params.source: which analytics source to include: 'all' (default, both source merged per property), 'google' (Google Analytics only — exclude property with no GA property), or 'firstParty' (self-hosted sessions-service only — exclude property with no sessions data).
get_web_analytics.params.breakdown: which report to give back: 'overview' (default; headline metric per property), 'timeseries' (daily series), 'pages' (top page), 'sources' (traffic source / referrer), 'geo' (country/city), or 'devices' (browser/OS/device type). for non-overview breakdown each property carry raw per-source list side by side.
get_ip_info.description: look up geolocation and network info for IP address. give back city, region, country, coordinate, and ISP/organization. skip ip or use 'self' for own IP.
get_ip_info.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: ip, hostname, city, region, country, latitude, longitude, org, postal, timezone
get_ip_info.params.ip: IP address to look up (like '8.8.8.8'). leave empty or 'self' for caller IP.
get_iss_location.description: get current position of International Space Station (latitude, longitude, timestamp) and astronaut now aboard.
get_iss_location.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: position.latitude, position.longitude, position.timestamp, astronauts.total, astronauts.people
get_light_health.description: get health and diagnostic from smart lighting service — uptime, current automation phase (sleep/sunrise/daytime/sunset/nighttime), night lock status, LIFX API rate limit, sunrise/sunset time, and weather condition.
get_local_environment.description: get cached environmental, weather, or space data for server local area. this give back pre-fetched data for server IP-based location — for weather at specific place, use get_weather instead. select source: current_weather, air_quality, earthquakes, solar_activity, aurora, twilight, tides, wildfires, iss, neo, solar_wind, pollen, apod, launches, warnings, air_quality_google, moon_phase.
get_local_environment.params.fields: comma-separated field to return (vary by source)
get_local_environment.params.source: which environmental data source to query
get_macro.description: access macroeconomic data from FRED. action: 'indicators' (key indicator summary), 'search' (search data series), 'series' (series metadata by ID), 'observations' (time series data point).
get_macro.params.seriesId: FRED series ID like 'GDP', 'UNRATE' (action=series or observations)
get_market_news.description: get latest market news article. can filter by company symbol for company-specific news.
get_market_news.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: category, datetime, headline, id, picture, related, source, summary, url
get_market_news.params.symbol: optional stock symbol for company-specific news
get_media_credits.description: get cast and crew credit for movie or TV show by TMDB ID.
get_media_details.description: get full detail for movie or TV show by TMDB ID — overview, genre, runtime, rating, revenue, production company, season (TV).
get_media_genres.description: get list of genre ID and name for movie or TV show. use these ID with browse_media.
get_media_recommendations.description: get recommended or similar movie/TV show based on TMDB ID. action: 'recommendations' (algorithm pick), 'similar' (same genre/keyword). good for 'if you liked X' suggestion.
get_moon_phase.description: get current moon phase using algorithmic calculation based on synodic lunar cycle (~29.53 day). give back phase name, illumination percent, age in day, waxing/waning state, and date for next new moon and full moon. no external API — computed from synodic period.
get_moon_phase.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: phaseName, phaseEmoji, illuminationPercent, ageInDays, synodicPeriodDays, isWaxing, isWaning, nextNewMoonUtc, nextFullMoonUtc
get_music.description: search and get music metadata from MusicBrainz. action: search_artists (find artist by name), artist (detail with discography, social link, tag), search_albums (find album by title, optional artist filter), album (detail with track listing, cover art, tag), search_tracks (find track by title).
get_music.params.artist: artist name to narrow album/track search (action=search_albums or search_tracks)
get_music.params.q: search query — artist name, album title, or track title
get_nasa_apod.description: get NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day. give back title, explanation, image URL (standard and HD), media type, date, and copyright.
get_nasa_apod.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: title, explanation, date, url, hdUrl, mediaType, copyright, lastFetch
get_natural_gas_prices.description: get U.S. natural gas price. filter by process type and geographic area.
get_near_earth_objects.description: get near-Earth object (asteroid) tracked by NASA. give back total count, hazardous count, closest approach detail (miss distance in km and lunar distance), largest object, and relative velocity. handle filter by lookback day and hazardous-only.
get_near_earth_objects.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: total, hazardousCount, closest.name, closest.missDistanceKm, closest.missDistanceLunar, closest.isPotentiallyHazardous, largest.name, lastFetch
get_near_earth_objects.params.hazardousO: if true, only return potentially hazardous asteroid
get_translink_next_bus.description: get real-time bus arrival estimate for TransLink (Vancouver) bus stop. show route, direction, expected arrival, countdown, schedule status, and cancelled trip.
get_translink_next_bus.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: stopNo, count, routes
get_now_playing_media.description: get movie now in theater, upcoming release, TV show airing today, or TV show now on air. action: 'now_playing' (theater), 'upcoming' (coming soon), 'airing_today' (TV today), 'on_the_air' (TV this week).
get_now_playing_media.params.action: what to get: now_playing, upcoming, airing_today, on_the_air
get_now_playing_media.params.region: ISO 3166-1 country code for theatrical region (default: US). movie action only.
get_nutritional_requirements.description: daily nutritional requirement target (RDA/AI/upper limit) from official standard: US DRI for human (adult_male, adult_female), AAFCO for dog and cat (adult_maintenance, puppy, kitten). pass weightKg to include weight-scaled protein and amino acid target; pass caloricIntake to scale pet per-1000kcal standard to actual diet.
get_nutritional_requirements.params.auth: standards body with data: US_DRI (human, default) or AAFCO (dog/cat, default for pet)
get_nutritional_requirements.params.calo: estimated daily caloric intake (kcal). essential for scaling AAFCO standard.
get_nutritional_requirements.params.life: target life stage or demographic. default: adult_male.
get_nutritional_requirements.params.weig: target body weight in kg. essential for scaling human amino acid limit.
get_on_this_day.description: get historical event, birth, death, or holiday that happened on specific date from Wikipedia. default to today.
get_on_this_day.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: date, type, count, events
get_on_this_day.params.type: type of event: selected, births, deaths, events, holidays
get_package_info.description: look up package on NPM or PyPI. give back version, description, dependency, license, README, weekly download (NPM), Python version requirement (PyPI). specify registry.
get_package_info.params.name: package name (like 'express', '@types/node', 'numpy')
get_package_info.params.readme: include README content (NPM only, default: true)
get_petroleum_prices.description: get U.S. petroleum/gasoline price including regular, midgrade, premium, and diesel retail price. filter by product type and geographic area.

get_petroleum_prices.params.product: product code (like 'EPM0' for regular gasoline, 'EPD2DXL0' for diesel)
get_pollen_forecast.description: get current pollen level for grass, tree, and weed allergen. give back index value (0-5), category, and whether each type in season. good for allergy and outdoor planning.
get_pollen_forecast.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: date, grass.displayName, grass.indexInfo.value, grass.indexInfo.category, grass.inSeason, tree.displayName, tree.indexInfo.value, tree.indexInfo.category, tree.inSeason, weed.displayName, weed.indexInfo.value, weed.indexInfo.category, weed.inSeason, regionCode, lastFetch
get_public_webcams.description: get list of public traffic and scenic webcam. give back camera name, location, coordinate, and URL.
get_public_webcams.params.province: Canada province or Australia state/province name.
get_public_webcams.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: id, name, url, area, latitude, longitude, city, country, source
get_pypi_package.description: look up Python package on PyPI. give back name, version, summary, author, license, homepage, repo URL, Python version requirement, and dependency.
get_pypi_package.params.name: PyPI package name (like 'numpy', 'requests', 'fastapi')
get_reddit_subreddit_feed.description: get hot, top, new, rising, or controversial post from specific subreddit.
get_reddit_subreddit_feed.params.limit: how many post to fetch (default: 25, max: 100)
get_reddit_subreddit_info.description: get metadata for specific subreddit including title, description, subscriber count, active user, rule, and NSFW status.
get_reddit_subreddit_rules.description: get community rule for specific subreddit.
get_reddit_subreddit_wiki_page.descripti: get markdown content of specific subreddit wiki page (like 'faq' or 'index').
get_reddit_subreddit_wiki_pages.descript: list all wiki page name for specific subreddit.
get_reddit_user_history.description: get recent activity (post and comment) of Reddit user, including karma level, timestamp, subreddit, and post title.
get_reddit_user_history.params.category: category of history to fetch (default: overview)
get_reddit_user_profile.description: get basic profile for Reddit user: username, creation date, karma, moderator status, and profile description.
get_satellite_imagery.description: get Landsat satellite imagery for any location on Earth via NASA Earth API. give back image URL, date, cloud score, and coordinate. can also list available date with action='assets'.
get_satellite_imagery.params.action: 'imagery' give back satellite photo, 'assets' list available date. default: imagery.
get_satellite_imagery.params.date: date of imagery (YYYY-MM-DD). default: most recent.
get_satellite_imagery.params.dimension: picture dimension in degree (like 0.025). default: API default.
get_sec_filings.description: access SEC EDGAR for institutional 13F filing (hedge fund holding), 10-K/10-Q report, 8-K event, insider transaction, and XBRL financial fact. action: 'filings' (by CIK), 'search' (find filer), 'facts' (XBRL financials).
get_sec_filings.params.cik: SEC CIK number (action=filings or facts). like '1067983' for Berkshire Hathaway
get_sec_filings.params.fields: comma-separated field to return. available: filer, filings, count
get_sec_filings.params.q: search query for finding filer (action=search). like 'Berkshire', 'Renaissance'
get_sector_performance.description: get S&P 500 sector performance heatmap using Select Sector SPDR ETF. show all 11 GICS sector with price, daily change, and top/bottom performer.

recipe.animate-generated-image.descripti: turn AI-made picture into moving vector animation with motion, easing, effect.

recipe.build-beat-from-samples.title: build beat or song from samples
recipe.build-beat-from-samples.descripti: sequence drum pattern, bassline, melody from real audio sample — drum machine / music tracker way.
recipe.build-beat-from-samples.steps: 1) generate_audio action 'init' make session. 2) one add_channel per sample: sampleSource 'preset:kick', 'preset:snare', 'preset:hat', 'preset:bass_pluck' (built-in library), or any audio URL / 'attached' user audio; each row retrigger sample, so repeat rows = beats. 3) write_pattern sequence rows per channel (KICK-style row = natural pitch; note row repitch). 4) render mix everything.
recipe.character-voice.title: character or robot voice
recipe.character-voice.description: make speech with fun character effect: robot, demon, chipmunk, radio announcer, megaphone, telephone.
recipe.character-voice.steps: 1) synthesize_speech make clean speech (return downloadUrl). 2) remix_audio with that URL as input and preset (robot, demon_voice, chipmunk, radio, telephone, megaphone) or custom operation chain.
recipe.clip-video-to-gif.title: clip video into GIF or short clip
recipe.clip-video-to-gif.description: find video online, download, cut moment into shareable GIF or trimmed clip.
recipe.clip-video-to-gif.steps: 1) search_videos find video (or use known URL). 2) download_video with format 'gif' convert direct, or format 'mp4' for full download. 3) trim_video cut exact start/end moment from mp4.
recipe.edit-generated-image.title: generate then edit image
recipe.edit-generated-image.description: make image then refine: crop, rotate, resize, remove background, filter, or verify content.
recipe.edit-generated-image.steps: 1) generate_image make image (return URL). 2) manipulate_image apply crop/rotate/resize/filter, or remove_background cut out subject. 3) describe_image can check result match intent. image URL chain — every tool output URL valid input to next.
recipe.master-audio-track.title: master or polish composed track
recipe.master-audio-track.description: compose music, then apply mastering effect: EQ, compression, reverb, bass boost, normalize, vinyl/lo-fi character.
recipe.master-audio-track.steps: 1) generate_audio compose and render track (return downloadUrl). 2) remix_audio with that URL apply mastering operation (equalizer, compressor, bass_boost, reverb, normalize) or character preset (vinyl, slowed_reverb, vaporwave).
recipe.mix-speech-over-music.title: layer speech or vocal over music
recipe.mix-speech-over-music.description: combine, mix, merge, or overlay many audio track — like voiceover or narration on top of music bed.
recipe.mix-speech-over-music.steps: 1) synthesize_speech make voice (return downloadUrl), or use any audio URL. 2) remix_audio with music as input and overlays: [{source: <speech URL>, offset: <second>, volume: 1.5-2}] mix into one file. concatenate join clip end-to-end instead.
recipe.sample-audio-from-web.title: sample sound from web
recipe.sample-audio-from-web.description: find any sound, song, or meme audio online, rip to mp3, use as instrument or beat in composition.
recipe.sample-audio-from-web.steps: 1) search_videos or search_youtube find source video. 2) download_video with format 'mp3' extract audio (return persistent downloadUrl). 3) for specific moment, remix_audio with trim operation (start/end second) isolate it. 4) generate_audio add_channel with sampleSource: <that URL> turn into tracker instrument — sequence as beat or repitched note.
recipe.transcribe-web-video.title: transcribe or summarize web video
recipe.transcribe-web-video.description: get spoken text of online video to quote, summarize, or analyze.
recipe.transcribe-web-video.steps: 1) search_videos find video. 2) for YouTube, get_youtube_video return transcript direct — fastest path. 3) for other platform or no-caption video: download_video with format 'mp3', then transcribe_audio with downloadUrl.
recipe.visualize-dataset.title: analyze data and chart it
recipe.visualize-dataset.description: compute, aggregate, or fetch data and turn numbers into bar/line/pie chart image.
recipe.visualize-dataset.steps: 1) execute_python compute/aggregate numbers (or query_datastore read stored records). 2) generate_chart render labels + datasets as chart image; call again with returned chartId to refine. chartImageUrl output chain into any image-accepting tool.
remix_audio.description: remix, MIX, COMBINE, overlay, layer, and apply audio effect to existing audio clip using FFmpeg DSP pipeline. this THE tool for merge many audio source: 'overlays' layer up to 8 extra track over input at chosen offset and volume (like speech/vocal over music, sound effect over recording), 'concatenate' join clip end-to-end — never use shell command or ffmpeg direct for audio mixing. accept audio from URL (including Discord attachment), base64 data URI, or local file path. apply composable chain of operation: pitch_shift, tempo, speed, reverb, echo, lowpass/highpass/bandpass filter, equalizer, bass_boost, treble_boost, distortion, chorus, flanger, phaser, tremolo, vibrato, compressor, normalize, reverse, fade, trim, volume, stereo_pan, bitcrush, and crystalizer. also handle 12 fun preset: chipmunk, demon_voice, nightcore, vaporwave, slowed_reverb, underwater, radio, telephone, robot, cave, vinyl, megaphone. for generating audio from scratch, use generate_audio instead.
remix_audio.params.input: audio source: public URL (including Discord CDN), base64 data URI, or local file path. if user attach audio but you have no URL, pass 'attached' — harness give newest attached audio.
remix_audio.params.overlays: extra audio track to MIX on top of input (max 8) — like layer speech over music, or stack many stem into one mix. each overlay is { source, offset?, volume? }. overlay mixed after input operation/preset applied. output length follow mixDuration.
remix_audio.params.overlays.items.params: audio to overlay: public https URL (like downloadUrl/audioRef from previous synthesize_speech or generate_audio result) or data URI. 'attached' NOT work here — only main input.
second into base track where overlay start (default 0, max 300). like 4 = overlay enter at 4-second mark.
gain for overlay, 0-4 (default 1.0). use ~1.5-2 so speech sit clear above music.
remix_audio.params.concatenate: audio source to append end-to-end AFTER input (max 8) — like stitch intro, main clip, outro into one file. each entry public https URL or data URI.
remix_audio.params.mixDuration: output length when overlay used: 'first' (default) = base input length (overlay past end get cut), 'longest' = extend to longest overlay (base padded with silence).
remix_audio.params.operations: ordered array of audio effect to apply sequentially. each operation has 'type' and type-specific parameter. operation applied in order, forming DSP pipeline.
remix_audio.params.operations.items.para: echo: array of decay value (0.0 to 0.9) matching delay.
echo: array of delay time in ms for multi-tap echo.
trim: end time in sec (absolute position, NOT duration). must be in same trim operation as 'start'.
tempo/speed: multiplier (0.25 to 4.0). 0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double. 'tempo' preserve pitch; 'speed' change pitch.
equalizer/bass_boost/treble_boost: gain in dB (−20 to +20). distortion: overdrive gain (0 to 100).
crystalizer: dynamic range expansion intensity (−10 to 10).
stereo_pan: pan position (−1.0 left to +1.0 right).
bitcrush: target sample rate for downsampling.
pitch_shift: how many semitone to shift (−24 to +24). +12 = one octave up (chipmunk), −12 = one octave down (demon).
trim: start time in sec (absolute position). combine with 'end' in single trim operation.
remix_audio.params.outputFormat: output audio format (default: 'wav'). use 'ogg' or 'opus' for Discord-optimized output.
remix_audio.params.preset: apply curated preset effect chain. preset expanded into operation sequence and applied before custom operation. can combine with extra operation.
remix_audio.params.sampleRate: output sample rate in Hz (default: preserve source). range: 8000 to 48000.
render_latex.description: render LaTeX mathematical expression as beautiful embedded page using KaTeX. use to display equation, formula, and mathematical notation. rendered equation show auto in tool result panel.
render_latex.params.displayMode: if true (default), render as display-style equation (centered, larger). if false, render inline.

replace_in_file.description: hash-anchor edit in file. THE tool for edit existing file (for create or full rewrite, use write_file). each edit point at line with `line#:hash` anchor prefix from read_file (like '42:k9x2') — never invent or retype hash. operation: 'replace' line or anchor..endAnchor range with new content, 'insert_after' anchor (anchor '0' = put at top of file), 'delete' line or range. all edit in one call checked against current file, applied all-or-nothing; line number mean file as caveman read it (edit never shift other edit). if file changed under anchor, call REJECTED with fresh `line#:hash|content` window around each stale line — re-anchor from window (or re-read just that range) and retry; never retry same stale anchor.
replace_in_file.params.anchor: `line#:hash` prefix of target line, copy exact from read (like '42:k9x2'). for insert_after, '0' mean insert before first line.
replace_in_file.params.endAnchor: optional `line#:hash` of last line of multi-line range (inclusive) for replace/delete.
replace_in_file.params.op: replace (default) = swap anchored line/range with 'content'; insert_after = put 'content' after anchored line; delete = remove anchored line/range.
replace_in_file.params.content: new text for replace/insert_after. can be many line. leave out for delete.
replace_in_file.params.path: absolute path to file to edit.
run_git.description: run git operation on repository. action: 'status' (branch, staged/unstaged/untracked file), 'diff' (show change), 'log' (commit history).
run_git.params.author: filter by author (log)

save_memory.description:
persist info to long-term agent memory. call in TWO case:
1. **explicit request**: human say 'remember', 'save', 'note', 'store', 'keep in mind', or 'no forget'.
2. **implicit preference signal**: human reveal personal preference, opinion, or fact about self. trigger pattern include: 'I like...', 'I love...', 'I hate...', 'I prefer...', 'my favorite...', etc. when in doubt, SAVE IT — over-remembering better than forgetting.

memory deduplicated auto. give back stored memory document or null if near-duplicate detected.
save_memory.params.content: memory content to persist. should be clear, self-contained statement.
save_memory.params.title: optional short label for memory. improve discoverability during semantic search.
save_memory.params.type: memory category. 'user' for personal preference, 'feedback' for correction, 'project' for codebase convention, 'reference' for technical fact. default: 'project'.

search_craigslist.description: search Craigslist classifieds for city and category. archive-first: every listing ever seen stored forever, results always come from archive. fresh page fetched from Craigslist max once per ~45 minute per unique search, under strict global daily budget — repeat call serve cached data, never trigger extra fetch, so call in loop no get fresher result. return title, price, URL, location, posted date (backfilled), first/last seen date, and if listing gone (probably sold). pass from/to to only ask archive by date range (never fetch).
search_craigslist.params.q: search words, like 'pokemon cards' or '2 bedroom apartment'.
search_craigslist.params.city: city name, like 'vancouver', 'seattle', 'san francisco'. most city map straight to Craigslist site; common alias handled.
search_craigslist.params.from: archive-only mode: ISO date lower bound on firstSeenAt (like '2026-07-01'). when from/to set, only stored result returned and Craigslist never contacted; return empty if nothing archived for range.
search_craigslist.params.to: archive-only mode: ISO date upper bound. see 'from'.
search_discord_messages.description: search Discord message history from server stored message. filter by guild, channel, user, time range, and keyword. handle three response mode: 'messages' give back full message object (default), 'count' give back ONLY matching count (use for 'how many' question), 'compact' give back minimal per-message data for scanning large result. max 200 result per call.

search_discord_messages.params.before: ISO date string — only message before this date
search_discord_messages.params.guildId: Discord guild/server ID to search within
search_discord_messages.params.limit: max result to return (default: 50, max: 200). not used in 'count' mode.
search_discord_messages.params.mode: response mode. 'messages' (default) give back full message object. 'count' give back only total count. 'compact' give back minimal data (author, first 120 char, date).
search_discord_messages.params.query: text search query — match against message content
search_discord_messages.params.messageId: exact message ID (snowflake) to grab — from reply chain or message link. give back that one message with attachments and embeds, bot messages too. beat query.
search_discord_messages.params.userId: filter to message by specific user ID
search_discord_messages.params.username: filter by username or display name (case-insensitive). use when you know person name but not user ID. search across username, global name, and server nickname.

search_drugs.params.q: search query — drug name, NDC code, ingredient, or class

search_energy.description: query EIA energy data for specific route with optional facet filter, date range, and frequency. give back time-series data point. use get_energy_catalog first to discover route and get_energy_facets to find valid filter value.
search_etsy.description: search active Etsy listing by keyword via official Etsy v3 API. give back title, price, favorite count, listing URL, creation date, and description snippet. handle price bound and sorting by relevance, recency, or price.
search_file_contents.description: search for literal string or regex pattern across file in directory. give back matching line with file path and line number. use to find function definition, usage pattern, import, variable reference. auto-skip node_modules, .git, and binary file. result capped at 50 match.

search_file_contents.params.isRegex: if true, treat pattern as regex. if false (default), treat as literal string.
search_file_contents.params.matchPerLine: if true (default), return each matching line with file and line number. if false, return only file name.
search_file_contents.params.pattern: search pattern — literal string or regex. use isRegex=true for regex mode.
search_file_contents.params.searchPath: absolute path to search in (file or directory).
search_food_substitutes.description: find nutritionally similar food substitute using cosine similarity on nutrient profile vector. good for dietary restriction, allergy, or preference. handle dietary preference filtering (vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian) and nutrient emphasis.
search_food_substitutes.params.excludeFo: comma-separated food name to exclude (allergy, etc.)
search_food_substitutes.params.food: source food to find substitute for (like 'salmon', 'beef', 'milk')
search_food_substitutes.params.targetNut: comma-separated nutrient to emphasize in matching (like 'protein,iron,omega3')

search_youtube.description: search YouTube for video matching query. give back ranked result with title, description, channel info, thumbnail, view count, like count, comment count, and duration. handle filtering by upload date, duration, sort order, specific channel, region, and safety level.
